definitions.explanation: The rounded front of the knee, as a colloquial and slightly affectionate word, typically used of a child's knees.

examples.japanese: {膝小僧|ひざこぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すりむいた→すりむく：09100_surimuku⟧。
⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{膝小僧|ひざこぞう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and my knee was bleeding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半|はん}ズボン→半ズボン：17405_hanzubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{膝小僧|ひざこぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}→絆創膏：05386_bansoukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}っていた→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: The children in shorts all had bandages on their knees.

notes:
USAGE:
- Used mostly in talk about children and scraped knees: {膝小僧|ひざこぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すりむく→すりむく：09100_surimuku⟧ is the set phrase. The ⟦{小僧|こぞう}→小僧：12388_kozou⟧ (little boy) gives the word its homely, affectionate tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧: knee, and also the lap; the general word. In anatomy the kneecap bone is {膝蓋骨|しつがいこつ}.
